After many months of prepara- 
tion, the Shanghai branch of the 
Sino-Japanese Cultural Association 
held its inaugural meeting at 2 
o’clock yesterday afternoon. The 
meeting took place at the Astor 
House with hundreds of Association 
members present. Mayor Chen 
Kung-po of Shanghai, Mr. Li Shih- 
chun, Minister of Police, Mr. Horiu- 
chi, Japanese” Consul-General, and 
many local Chinese and Japanese 
high officials were also present; 
according to the Central Press. 

The auditorium was decorated 
with Chinese and Japanese national 
flags and fiowers. The opening 
ceremony began at 2 p.m. with music 
by the. band of the Shanghai Muni- 
cipality. 5

the Preparatory Committee. made a 
report on the .circumstances sur- 
rounding the -formation of the

Shih-chun for the assistance ‘rend- 
ered: to the Preparatory Committee 
in s@curing premises fér the Asso- 
ciation in Shanghai.

pounded on the definition of culture 
and the histopy of the éultural co- 


operation between China and Japan. 
He also urged the members of the 
‘Association to pay more attention !

ing utterences.

OPENING CEREMONY OF SHANGHAI BRANCH OF SINO-JAPANESE
CULTURAL ASSOCIATION

The opening ceremony of the Shanghai
Branch of the Sino-Japanese Cultural Association was held
at its premises at No. 15 Jessfield Road yesterday morning.
Amongst those who were present were Mayor Chen Kung-po as
a representative of Chairman Wang Ching-wei and Dr. Chu
Min-yi, Chairman of the head office of the Sino-Japanese
Association.
At 11 a.m. the executive and supervisory
committeemen held their first meeting. Li Shih-chun
(李士群), Chairman of the Shanghai Branch of the
Association, specially came to Shanghai from Nanking to
attend the meeting.
The Branch has laid down the following
schemes :-
(1) To make preparations for the opening of supplementary
schools which will be divided into two departments,
namely, the Chinese language department and the
Japanese language department.
(2) To make preparations for the opening of a library.
(3) To publish a series of books on the Chinese and
Japanese languages.
(4) To invite prominent Chinese and Japanese to deliver
speeches.
(5) To hold Chinese and Japanese writing and drawing
exhibitions and also photograph exhibitions.
(6) To hold meetings to study literature and arts.
Branch have standing members : Matsumura and Wong Tien-moo (王天木) with
Chief Secretary :
Chief Executives : Chow Tse-chen (周澤陳) with
Ishihara as assistant.
Chiefs of the Tuition Section : Yuen Ts (袁珠)
and Nakada.
Chiefs of the Literature Section : Chow Sin-pah
(周新伯) and Uyeno.
Chief of the Sports Section : Wong Tien-moo.

中日文化协会上海分会成立典礼

中日文化协会上海分会的成立典礼于昨日上午在该会极司菲尔路15号会所举行。出席者包括作为汪精卫主席代表的陈公博市长，以及中日协会总办事处董事长褚民谊博士。
上午11时，执行委员和监察委员举行了第一次会议。协会上海分会会长李士群（李士群）特地从南京来沪出席会议。
该分会制定了以下计划：
(1) 筹备开设补习学校，分为中文部和日文部两个部门。
(2) 筹备开设图书馆。
(3) 出版一系列中日文书籍。
(4) 邀请中日知名人士发表演讲。
(5) 举办中日书画展览及摄影展览。
(6) 举行文学艺术研讨会。
分会常务会员有：松村和王天木（王天木），

New China Daily News published the following list on
March 22 and 23, 1941 :-

BRIEF PARTICULARS ABOUT JAPANESE CULTURAL INSTITUTIONS
IN CENTRAL CHINA

The cultural movement of the Japanese in
Central China was not so conspicuous prior to the outbreak
of the Sino-Japanese hostilities as it is at present.
After the outbreak of hostilities, with the progress of
the war and the restoration of peace and order, the
significance of Central China to Japan and the political
and economic developments, members of Japanese cultural
circles began to work hard to promote this movement in
Shanghai and Nanking with the co-operation of members of
Chinese cultural bodies.

The object of this movement is to spread
new thoughts and ideas for the rejuvenation of Asia as
well as to maintain a close touch with military movements.

The following is a list of cultural
institutions and organs located in Shanghai:-

(1) Tairiku Shimpo and its Chinese edition
the Sin Shun Pao

Under the guidance of the Publicity Bureau
of the local Japanese military headquarters, this paper
holds the same position as the "Shanghai Mainichi." Its
managing-director is A. B...
the "Sin Shun Pao" which is in receipt of a subsidy from
the Asia Rehabilitation Board.

(2) The Yangtsekiang Publishing Company (揚子江社)

This company is under the management of
J. Yamada and is the publisher of a magazine called
"Shanghai" (上海).
pages.zh:
《新华日报》于1941年3月22日和23日刊登了以下名单：

华中地区日本文化机构简况

在中日战事爆发前，日本人在华中地区的文化活动并不像现在这样引人注目。战事爆发后，随着战争的进展以及和平与秩序的恢复，鉴于华中地区对日本的重要性以及政治和经济的发展，日本文化界人士开始与中国文化团体成员合作，努力在上海和南京推动这一运动。

这场运动的目的是传播复兴亚洲的新思想和新理念，并与军事行动保持密切联系。

以下是位于上海的文化机构和机关名单：

(1) 《大陆新报》及其中文版《新申报》

在当地日军司令部宣传部的指导下，该报的地位与《上海每日新闻》相同。其总经理是 A. B...
《新申报》接受东亚复兴委员会的资助。

(2) 扬子江社（揚子江社）

该公司由 J. Yamada 管理，出版名为《上海》（上海）的杂志。

pages.en:
- 2 -

(4) The Central China Printing Press (華中印書局)
This printing press was established for military
requirements in the former premises of the printing
department of the World Bookstore (世界書局). It is
under the management of J. Imai and has special connections
with the San Tung Bookstore (三通書局). This printing
press undertakes the printing of new textbooks on the
basis of the principles for the rejuvenation of Asia, while
the San Tung Bookstore, which is under the management of
M. Nakamura, acts as its publishing organ.

(5) The China United Press Service (中華聯合通訊社)
This news agency was established in the summer
of 1939 by Okumiya and several others for the purpose of
supplying news sheets to newspapers and magazines in Central
China. Since its reorganization, its sphere of activities
has been reduced.

(6) The Dah Chung Bookstore (大中書局)
This bookstore is the publishing organ of
children's magazines in the Chinese language, such as
the "Friend Pictorial" (友好畫報). It is a private
enterprise of R. Yunari.

(7) The China Motion Picture Company (中華電影公司)
This company is registered in the name of R.
Yunari and is under the good management of K. Negishi. It
is the only motion picture manufacturing company owned by
Japanese in Central China and was established in July, 1937,
with a capital of Yen 1,000,000. The affairs of the
company are in the hands of N. Kawakita, who is the
Director of the Distributing Depot of a well-known Japanese
film company known as the Kawakita Film Co. Recently,
the company established a depot for the manufacture of
cultural lantern-slides.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

(4) 华中印书局（華中印書局）
该印刷厂是为了满足军事需求，在世界书局（世界書局）印刷部原址建立的。由 J. Imai 管理，与三通书局（三通書局）有特殊联系。该印刷厂根据复兴亚洲的原则承印新教科书，而由 M. Nakamura 管理的三通书局则充当其出版机构。

(5) 中华联合通讯社（中華聯合通訊社）
该通讯社由 Okumiya 等人于1939年夏季成立，旨在向华中地区的报纸和杂志提供新闻稿。重组后，其活动范围有所缩小。

(6) 大中书局（大中書局）
该书店是《友好画报》（友好畫報）等中文儿童杂志的出版机构。它是 R. Yunari 的私营企业。

(7) 中华电影公司（中華電影公司）
该公司以 R. Yunari 的名义注册，由 K. Negishi 良好管理。它是华中地区唯一的日资电影制造公司，成立于1937年7月，资本为100万日元。公司事务由 N. Kawakita 掌管，他是著名日本电影公司川北电影公司发行部主任。最近，该公司建立了一个文化幻灯片制造 depot（仓库/分部）。

pages.en:
- 3 -

(8) The China Cultural Service Agency (中國文化服務社)
It is under the management of Kawazoe and is
under the guidance of the Military Publicity Bureau. It
is the publisher of the "China Monthly Magazine" (中國月刊)
and a children's magazine called "Young Friend" (小朋友).

(9) The China Women's Co-Operative Association
(中國婦女協進會)
This Association is located in Pootung and
was established by Miss Yang Chia-hsiang (楊嘉音) and
Miss Y. Yamakishi under the protection of the Japanese
Navy. It is an educational body for Chinese women. It
operates a maternity hospital in Pootung and runs a
Japanese language school on Nanking Road.

(10) The Shanghai Cultural Club (上海文化俱樂部)
This club was established in December last year
by M. Nakamura, T. Tsuruhiro and T. Shumura; its object is
to develop and promote culture in the New East.

(11) The Shanghai Artists' League (上海美術家聯盟)
This League was formed by M. Tanimato of the
Free Drawing Research Institute, K. Kawarazuka of the
Green Pagoda Drawing Research Institute, and several others.
It was originally known as the Shanghai Arts Association.

(12) The Shanghai Chorus Group (上海歌壇) and
The Dah Loh Chorus Group (大陸歌壇)
These two bodies use newspapers for the
publication of their propaganda. The former is under the
direction of K. Miura and T. Ishii and its propaganda is
conducted through the medium of the Shanghai Mainichi,
while the latter is under the management of Hizuku with
the Tairiku Shimpo as an outlet for its propaganda.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

(8) 中国文化服务社（中國文化服務社）
由 Kawazoe 管理，受军方宣传部指导。它是《中国月刊》（中國月刊）和名为《小朋友》的儿童杂志的出版商。

(9) 中国妇女协进会（中國婦女協進會）
该协会位于浦东，由杨嘉音小姐（楊嘉音）和 Y. Yamakishi 小姐在日本海军的保护下成立。它是一个针对中国女性的教育机构。它在浦东经营一家妇产医院，并在南京路开办一所日语学校。

(10) 上海文化俱乐部（上海文化俱樂部）
该俱乐部由 M. Nakamura、T. Tsuruhiro 和 T. Shumura 于去年12月成立；其宗旨是发展和促进新东方的文化。

(11) 上海美术家联盟（上海美術家聯盟）
该联盟由自由绘画研究所的 M. Tanimato、绿塔绘画研究所的 K. Kawarazuka 等人组成。原名上海艺术协会。

(12) 上海歌坛（上海歌壇）和
大陆歌坛（大陸歌壇）
这两个团体利用报纸发布其宣传内容。前者由 K. Miura 和 T. Ishii 指导，通过《上海每日新闻》进行宣传；后者由 Hizuku 管理，以《大陆新报》作为其宣传渠道。

pages.en:
- 15 -

(13) The Yangtse Cultural Study Association
(長江文學會)
It was formed jointly by A. Nonaka and Y.
Kunimi of the Shanghai Cultural Study Association, and
T. Takagi and K. Senda of the Shang Kiang Cultural Study
Association in summer last year. The "Saturday Cultural
Column" of the Tairiku Shimpo is reserved for its
propaganda. It is also the publisher of a magazine known
as "Yangtse Literature" (長江文學).
(14) Asia Rehabilitation Literature (興亞文學)
This is not a cultural body. It is simply a
kind of movement promoted in December last year under the
joint auspices of Nakai, Sato, Yamada and other reporters
of the Shanghai Mainichi for the promotion of a cultural
movement through the medium of the Shanghai Mainichi.
(15) The New Womanhood (新女性)
This is a Chinese language magazine for women
published by T. Shumura of the China Problems Study
Institute (中國問題研究所)
(16) The Dah Loh Correspondence Agency (大陸往來社)
It is a publishing company established in
September last year by I. Owa and is the publisher of a
magazine known as the Dah Loh Correspondence (大陸往來)
which enjoys as good circulation as the "Yangtsekiang" (揚子江).
(17) The Shanghai Children's Cultural Association
(上海兒童文化協會)
It was established under the guidance of Y.
Kiyomatsu of the Cultural Bureau of the Asia Rehabilitation
Board in autumn last year. Its object is to develop culture
among children in Central China. Most of the members of
this Association are teachers. The promoter himself was
at one time a teacher.
pages.zh:
- 15 -

(13) 长江文学会 (The Yangtse Cultural Study Association)
该会由上海文化研究会的 A. Nonaka（音译）和 Y. Kunimi（音译），以及上江文化研究会的 T. Takagi（音译）和 K. Senda（音译）于去年夏季联合组建。《大陆新报》的“周六文化专栏” reserved for its propaganda（保留用于其宣传）。该会也是名为《长江文学》杂志的出版方。
(14) 兴亚文学 (Asia Rehabilitation Literature)
这不是一个文化团体。它仅仅是一种运动，由《上海每日新闻》的中井 (Nakai)、佐藤 (Sato)、山田 (Yamada) 等记者于去年十二月在《上海每日新闻》的共同支持下发起，旨在通过该报促进文化运动。
(15) 新女性 (The New Womanhood)
这是一本由中国问题研究所的 T. Shumura（音译）出版的女性中文杂志。
(16) 大陆往来社 (The Dah Loh Correspondence Agency)
这是一家由 I. Owa（音译）于去年九月成立的出版公司，是名为《大陆往来》杂志的出版方，其发行量与《扬子江》相当。
(17) 上海儿童文化协会 (The Shanghai Children's Cultural Association)
该会于去年秋季在兴亚院文化局 Y. Kiyomatsu（音译）的指导下成立。其宗旨是在华中地区的儿童中发展文化。该协会的成员大多是教师。发起人本人也曾是一名教师。

(18) The East Asia Women's Association (东亚妇女协会)
It is under the management of Miss T. Haruno
and is one of the leading cultural bodies of Chinese women.
It was formed in September last year and conducts many
charity enterprises.
(19) The Sino-Japanese Friendship Association
for Women (日华女子亲善会)
It is under formation by S. Makiguchi. No
particulars are at present available.
In addition to the foregoing, there are also
the following cultural bodies and magazines in Shanghai,
namely:-
(1) The Far East Dramatic Group (远东剧团).
(2) The New Life Monthly (新命月刊).
(3) The New East Asia (新东亚).
(4) The Shanghai Natural Science Study Institute

(5) The Shanghai Modern Science Library 上海近代科学图书馆

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

Date January 30 1941.

REPORT

Subject Inaugural meeting of the Branch Association in Shanghai of the
Sino-Japanese Cultural Association.

Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by J. L. Crawford

With reference to the attached translation
of an article appearing in the January 29th
issue of the Tairiku Shimpo regarding the inaugural
meeting of the Sino-Japanese Cultural Association
in Shanghai, I have to state that the meeting
took place in the Astor House Hotel at 2 p.m.
January 29th, attended by prominent Sino-Japanese
officials and civilians.

The meeting was opened with a speech by
Mr. Chow Sin Fan (周新伯), which was followed
by the reading of messages of felicitation by
Mr. Chen Kung Po (陳公博), Mayor of the Shanghai
City Government, Mr. Horiuchi, Consul-General in
Shanghai, Dr. Chu Min Yi (褚民), Chinese
Ambassador to Tokyo, and Mr. Li Shin Chung
(李士群).

A copy of the regulations of the Shanghai
Branch of the Association together with a message
will be sent to Mr. Wang Ching Wei, President of
the Nanking Government, was then decided upon.
After the election of the undermentioned officials
of the association the meeting was adjourned at
4 p.m.

Japanese Officials
Honorary Presidents
Mr. Horiuchi, Consul-General in Shanghai.
Vice-Admiral S. Tsuda, Director of the
Central China Liaison Office.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）

报告

事由：中日文化协会上海分会成立大会。

会议以周新伯先生的演讲开幕，随后宣读了上海市政府市长陈公博先生、驻上海总领事堀内 (Horiuchi) 先生、中国驻东京大使褚民谊博士和李士群先生的贺词。

in re. 31/1/41
Bennett）

Sino-Japan Cultural Body
Inaugurated Here

Association Holds First Assembly At Astor House;
Speechmakers Stress Existing Bonds
Between Two Nations

After many months of prepara-
tion, the Shanghai branch of the
Sino-Japanese Cultural Association
held its inaugural meeting at 2
o'clock yesterday afternoon. The
meeting took place at the Astor
House with hundreds of Association
members present. Mayor Chen
Kung-po of Shanghai, Mr. Li Shih-
chun, Minister of Police, Mr. Horiu-
chi, Japanese Consul-General, and
many local Chinese and Japanese
high officials were also present,
according to the Central Press.

The auditorium was decorated
with Chinese and Japanese national
flags and flowers. The opening
ceremony began at 2 p.m. with music
by the band of the Shanghai Muni-
cipality.

Mr. Chow Hsin-pai, member of
the Preparatory Committee, made a
report on the circumstances sur-
rounding the formation of the
Shanghai Branch of the Sino-
Japanese Cultural Association. Mr.
Chow, in his report, thanked Mr. Li
Shih-chun for the assistance rend-
ered to the Preparatory Committee
in securing premises for the Asso-
ciation in Shanghai.

Mayor Chen in a short speech ex-
pounded on the definition of culture
and the history of the cultural co-
operation between China and Japan.
He also urged the members of the
Association to pay more attention
to actual work than to high sound-
ing utterences.

Importance Of Shanghai Stressed
Mr. Horiuchi then spoke specially
emphasizing the important position
of Shanghai as the cultural and
economic centre of China. He
encouraged the members of the
Shanghai Branch to strive even
more than elsewhere to make
Shanghai not only a model area of
the cultural co-operation but of
political and economic harmony
between China and Japan.

Mr. Li Shih-chun clearly explain-
ed the significant task and import-
ance of the establishment of the
Sino-Japanese Cultural Association.
He said: "It is a glorious page in
the history of Eastern and Western
culture," In conclusion, he voiced
the hope that the Shanghai branch
would shoulder boldly the responsi-
bility it was undertaken and
seriously accomplish the task
bestowed upon it by the new era.

Officers Elected
The regulations and a draft tele-
gram to President Wang Ching-wei
were unanimously passed at the
meeting.

The meeting also elected Mayor
Chen Kung-po, Consul-General
Horiuchi and Mr. Tsuda as Honorary
Chairmen of the Board of Directors;
Mr. Li Shih-chun, Chairman of the
Board of Directors; Messrs. Lu
Chun-chiang, Tang Leang-li and 21
others as Honorary Directors; Mr.
Chow Hsin-pai, Mr. Ito and 18 other
Chinese and Japanese members as
Directors, Mr. Chang Feng-pai and
9 others as reserve Directors; and
Messrs. Hu Tse-wu, Chen Shao-wei,
Kishizawa and Hirazawa as
Supervisors.

贝内特 (Bennett)）

中日文化团体
在此成立

协会在礼查饭店举行首次大会；
演讲者强调两国间现有纽带

经过数月的准备，中日文化协会上海分会于昨天下午2时举行了成立大会。据中央通讯社报道，会议在礼查饭店举行，数百名协会会员出席。上海市市长陈公博、警政部长李士群、日本总领事堀内以及许多当地中日高级官员也出席了会议。

礼堂装饰着中日两国国旗和鲜花。开幕式于下午2时开始，由上海工部局乐队演奏音乐。

筹备委员会委员周新伯先生就中日文化协会上海分会成立的背景情况作了报告。周先生在报告中感谢李士群先生为筹备委员会在上海争取协会会所所提供的协助。

陈市长在简短的演讲中阐述了文化的定义以及中日文化交流合作的历史。他还敦促协会会员更多地关注实际工作，而非高谈阔论。

强调上海的重要性
随后，堀内先生发表讲话，特别强调了上海作为中国文化和经济中心的重要地位。他鼓励上海分会的成员比在其他地方更加努力，使上海不仅成为中日文化交流合作的模范区，也成为政治和经济和谐的模范区。

李士群先生清楚地解释了建立中日文化协会的重大任务和重要性。他说：“这是东西方文化历史上光辉的一页。”最后，他表示希望上海分会能勇敢地承担起所承担的责任，认真完成新时代赋予的任务。

选举职员
会议一致通过了章程和致汪精卫主席的电文草案。

会议还选举陈公博市长、堀内总领事和津田先生为董事会名誉主席；李士群先生为董事会主席；陆春江、唐良里等21人为名誉董事；周新伯先生、伊藤先生及其他18名中日成员为董事；张凤柏等9人为候补董事；胡泽武、陈绍伟、岸泽 (Kishizawa) 和平泽 (Hirazawa) 为监事。
